lines.text: Many learners say: It takes one hour half.
Better: It takes one hour and a half.
And a half! It takes one hour and a half.

data.right: It takes one hour and a half.

native.tip: 한국어 “한 시간 반”은 ‘반’만 붙이면 되지만, 영어는 one hour and a half처럼 and a를 넣어요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “It takes one hour and a half.”

en.tip: Add and a before half. Say “It takes one hour and a half.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “It takes one hour half.” Add and a before half. Right: “It takes one hour and a half.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
